description: 福岡｜のんびり描いてます｜有償依頼受付中｜aotomoke@gmail.com

works.body:
Hello moke-sensei. Your art is so cute!

I'd like to request an illustration of my vtuber, Fleur. She's a swan with a gentle princess-like personality and appearance. Her clothing style is based on ballet costumes.
Her charm points are her moles and wing hair accessory so I'd like to request that you keep them in the illustration. Please feel free to simplify any details and decorations to fit with your art style~
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1s6nTiqgG95bU2tBFoidE44xdkRR28x2h

I would like to use the illustration as a SNS header (Twitter, Youtube) so please make it horizontal. I don't have any other requests so I'll leave the pose and rest of the composition up to you.

Thank you so much for your consideration!💕

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1s6nTiqgG95bU2tBFoidE44xdkRR28x2h

こんにちは！snsであなたの絵を見ました。僕のキャラクター "Soyuu "を描いてくれないかな。彼女は内気な堕天使です。青い髪に黒い後光と翼があり、白いふわふわしたワンピースに黒いハーネスをつけています。ペットはハチ。ポーズはお任せするから、好きにしていいよ～。

sns/Youtube/Twitchで使用します。よろしくお願いします！
